instruction: A candid outdoor photograph, close-up shot, captures a couple hugging in a snowy winter forest. The woman in the grey beanie (R1) stands on the right in a black leather jacket, her eyes closed in a peaceful smile. She wraps her arms around the man in the black beanie (R2), who wears a brown coat and stands on the left with his back partially turned. She rests her head gently against his shoulder. The background features soft, snow-laden trees under diffused winter light, casting a cool, quiet, and intimate atmosphere over the scene.
elements: R1 wraps her arms around R2
R1 rests her head against R2's shoulder
R2 has his back partially turned while R1 leans into him
R1 is the person smiling peacefully with eyes closed during the embrace
R2 is the person whose shoulder receives R1's head
the setting is a snowy winter forest with snow-laden trees

questions.q: Does R1 wrap her arms around R2, rather than R2 being the one specifically described as wrapping his arms around R1?
questions.element: R1 has the active arm-wrapping role around R2

questions.element: R1 rests her head on R2's shoulder

questions.element: R2's back is partially turned as R1 leans against him
